abstract_claim: This note consolidates the recent P vs NP discovery cycles into a scoped theorem pair. Transparent FormulaEval row support extends the Gamma parser ledger and yields an upper-bound falsifier; hidden semantic support is blocked by a private-row or unread-enable-bit countermodel.

countermodel_theorem.blocked_escape: RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N remains the only possible escape: it must force every semantically influential row into visible, charged support.
countermodel_spine: Choose a row r* not present in the parsed support Q_pi.
Let a hidden enable bit or semantic selector decide whether r* participates in FormulaEval.
Keep all displayed proof bits and charged occurrence neighborhoods fixed.
Flip the uncharged SAT/FormulaEval value at r*.
The parser outputs the same transcript while the selected support or H_N^SAT parity changes.
countermodel_theorem.statement: If a FormulaEval mechanism lacks visible row support, selector extensionality, influence closure, or a charged semantic-realizer, then a private-row or unread-enable-bit construction gives two proof surfaces with the same parsed transcript but different FormulaEval dependence or carrier parity. Occurrence completion is therefore invalid.

definition_fields.influence_closure: every row whose SAT value can change a FormulaEval line is included in the charged support
definition_fields.no_hidden_advice: row support cannot be supplied by nonuniform tables, semantic oracles, or private enable bits unless charged
definition_fields.row_enumeration_or_scan_charge: either RowSetEnumerator_N outputs selected rows with certified cost U_N or the parser pays the full scan charge F_FE N^{1+q+o(1)}
definition_fields.row_expansion_charge: each distinct selected row contributes the complete occurrence/SAT expansion term, typically N times the row count or T_N M_N in projected formulations
definition_fields.same_theory_parser: all support, selector, extension, and SAT occurrence conventions are read by the same proof verifier and circuit model
definition_fields.visible_selector_code: the proof displays the row predicate, extension rule, or enumerator certificate used to select rows

examples_subsumed: projected guarded-dDNNF with witness or projected-enumerator charge
next_paper_action: Write the TransparentRowSupport_N theorem/countermodel pair as the paper core before running more exploratory cycles.
non_claims: This does not prove P != NP.
This does not prove SAT outside P/poly.
This is a proof-system transfer obstruction and parser/falsifier boundary.
open_problems: RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N: force semantic FormulaEval influence into visible charged support.
AC0PrefixNonemptiness_N or an equivalent output-sensitive enumeration theorem for AC0 selectors.
Prior-art comparison against hardness magnification, MCSP/MKtP, natural proofs, relativization, and algebrization.

examples_subsumed: projected guarded-dDNNF with witness or projected-enumerator charge
proof_spine: Parse all bEF, SATeq, bounded-SR_h, and extension dependencies into Gamma_bEF.
Use visible selector or enumerator fields to compute the complete FormulaEval row support or pay full scan.
Apply influence closure so every SAT row that can alter a FormulaEval line enters the charged support.
Expand each charged row into the same occurrence/SAT representation used by the carrier H_N^SAT.
Compose the public generator, parsed transcript, and residual patches into a nonuniform circuit for H_N^SAT.
Contradict LB_N(1+epsilon) exactly when the total size is subthreshold.
positive_theorem.statement: If a Psys_sym FormulaEval mechanism satisfies TransparentRowSupport_N with discovery charge U_N, row-support size T_N, and FormulaEval expansion charge X_N, then the existing bEF parser extends to Gamma_trans(pi)=Gamma_bEF(pi)+U_N+X_N. If N^{rho+o(1)}+Gamma_trans(pi)<N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}, the alleged LB_N(1+epsilon) certificate is falsified in the same nonuniform SIZE model.

stop_rule: Do not add more selector classes unless they either instantiate TransparentRowSupport_N as a nontrivial example needed by the paper or disprove one of its definition fields. The next cycle must draft/prove the generic theorem pair.
title: Transparent Row Support for FormulaEval: A Parser/Falsifier Boundary
